newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 2.764 billion yuan from 2.345 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was more active than on Monday with short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, trading actively, traders said.

The centres lent out enough funds to balance out the trading activities of non-bank financial instititions including the securities houses which traded actively on the volatile stock markets, they said.
The China Securities newspaper said China's retail price inflation rate dropped to a year-on-year 1.1 percent in April against a year-on-year 6.1 percent last year.
Traders said falling inflation would depress the interbank rates in the mid-term.
